reviews.text: I highly recommend Joe, Nick Picca and their team.  Their work is of high quality and they are attentive to every detail of a project.  They installed a new driveway, sidewalk, apron, and pavers at my home and had fantastic landscape design ideas.  Completely updated the exterior of my home.  I will definitely use them again for future projects!

They walked me through exactly how the job would be done, told me when they would do it, and advised me that my 50 year old steps may crack and how they would replace/repair if needed.

The crew showed up on time, paid attention to detail work, were especially careful when moving the stone steps and completed the job without damage to them. All in 95 degree humid heat.

I highly recommend Picca.
Have known Joseph Picca for years. He and his crew have performed several jobs for me and our family. Nothing but the BEST. If you are looking for a Quality Job, look no further.
Working with Picca was a pleasure. They were very responsive and professional. They do quality work and show up when they say they will. Highly recommend.
